_doc: Per-character intro story pages (originally pre-rendered images). Index = character (0 Meatball ... 7 Xiao Ming), pages in display order. Rendered by tools/gfx_intro.py.
0: The little imp had just learned the truth: he was the secret love child of the Lord of Heaven and the Demon Queen...
After many failed talks with the Lord of Heaven, Queen Sago, bitter at being abandoned, decided to take revenge.
One day, Sago received an invitation to the VF Association's Crazy Tycoon contest. Her revenge had officially begun...
So Sago ordered the little imp to enter the Crazy Tycoon contest, win it, and conquer Heaven in one stroke.
The imp grudgingly obeyed... but it seemed he had a wish of his own...
1: One day, the happy little angel's innocent fate took a dramatic turn...
While the little angel was sweeping the courtyard, a mysterious mailman delivered two letters for the Lord of Heaven: one from Sago, Queen of Hell, and one an invitation from the VF Association.

Curious, Dubi opened the Queen's letter and discovered that his philandering father, the Lord of Heaven, had a love child with the Demon Queen, the same age as him! Bitter at being abandoned, she had ordered that little imp to win the Crazy Tycoon contest and conquer Heaven.
Furious, Dubi resolved to defeat the imp from Hell with his own strength and stop Sago's plan...
2: The world's richest man, Moneybags Qian, was getting on in years when, by great good luck, he had a daughter.
Time flew. Seventeen years later the girl had become a dazzling beauty, and a life of luxury convinced her she was a queen blessed by Heaven.
But at the Miss World pageant she lost miserably... Her confidence shattered, the whole world turned a dreary gray...
On her 18th birthday an invitation arrived from the VF Association, and the fire in her life blazed bright once more.
She decided the time had come to become Queen of the World...
3: "Boss Guts" has always been his proudest underworld title. But everybody knows that calling him by his full name is the worst insult there is.
One day a youngster broke that taboo and paid the ultimate price... and Boss Guts was arrested. Behind bars on Green Island, his heart grew colder by the day...
Water wears away stone~ One day Boss Guts finally dug through the Green Island prison with his one spoon, swam back to Taiwan on sheer guts, and began his life on the run.
Then, while hiding out somewhere with his henchmen, he mysteriously received an invitation from the VF Association.
He believed it was his ticket off the run...
4: War broke out in the South Seas, and my husband Ryuji was sent to the front.
Three years have passed with no word from Ryuji. "He must still be alive," I keep telling myself...
No... I don't believe it! They say these ashes are Ryuji?
Ryuji... when will I see your loving eyes again...
What's this? "Crazy Tycoon Invitation"? Is this the legendary Crazy Tycoon that grants wishes?
5: He is Japan's most gorgeous superstar idol!
He believes his calling in show business is to show everyone just how unfair the Creator was.
His heart is 200% full of himself, with no room left for anything else.
He is his own true love. If he can't see himself for five minutes, he falls into hysterics.
One day he received an invitation from the VF Association. Inspiration struck! What better chance to make the whole world envy his beauty?
And so, in all his glorious beauty, he set out for the VF Association...
6: Darn it~ Everybody calls me a tigress...
That's right~ Wong Fei-hung is my ancestor. Maybe his blood runs in my veins. Smashing boulders bare-handed is no big deal for me~
Ooh~ how romantic, Titanic... Wait! Is that a dig at me? I am NOT a tigress nobody wants! Stupid Titanic!
A VF Association invitation? What's this? The contest that grants wishes? Hohoho~ Now who'll say nobody wants me!
7: His father died young, and when he was five his mother was left paralyzed by a car accident...
He has a pitiful little face, and years of practice taught him to win people over with his sad story and cash in on it...
"For money, anything goes." These are the words he lives by.
One day he swindled a VF Association invitation out of someone, and decided to escape his life of poverty...
